evidence.title: ExecRubrics: Executable Tool-Augmented Rubrics for Verifiable and Efficient Long-Form Evaluation

summary: ExecRubrics is a new executable framework designed to enhance the verifiability and efficiency of long-form AI evaluations. The tool-augmented approach aims to standardize and improve the assessment of AI-generated content.
title: Researchers Introduce ExecRubrics: A Tool-Augmented Framework for Verifiable Long-Form AI Evaluation
